*Tick tick tick* *BZZZzzzzzttt* 

[h1][b][u]IMPORTANT PLEASE READ IF USING UNOFFICIAL RUSSIAN LOCALISATION[/u][/b][/h1]

[I]If you are using the Siberian GRemlin release of the Russian localisation, and the game crashes upon trying to start, please uninstall it as there will be issues with the new patch due to changes to the text.

You can uninstall Siberian GRemlin's release by running the uninstaller that came bundled with it.

Alternatively, if you are unsure about this delete everything in the DATA folder EXCEPT the DATA.FIL file, delete any external fonts in the FONTS folder too. After doing this please verify your game to ensure that nothing is missing from it.[/I]


[h1][u]CONSTRUCTOR - ABOUT BLOODY TIME! UPDATE[/u][/h1]

Yes, you wonderful people, that's the sound of an update being released for Constructor, and it's about bloody time if you ask us! Now, we realise that the last time we released an update for the game man had only just discovered fire (has it really been that long?!), but we've been hard at work improving multiple areas of the game. So, whilst your update is in progress let's sit down and talk about some of these improvements.

Oh, but where are my manners? I am, of course, the brightful BrightPaw who will be bringing you yet another announcement from within the bowels of hel-System 3. So without further ado, let's take a trip down patch-way pass. Oh, and don't feed the programmers!


[h1][u]NEW FEATURES[/u][/h1]
In this patch we will be introducing a number of new things to Constructor.

The first is, of course, the new net-code but as this has its own section down below we will save the nattering until then.

When you start the game up you may notice several new fences in the game which can be built for your tenants. Each of these have their own defensive values as well as stress factors. On the topic of defensive values, the value displayed for fences no longer correlates to a rough idea of how many hits they can take before a foreman removes it. 

Each fence now provides a bonus to the property it surrounds in terms of protecting from nearby explosions. So, if you're planning on building a hedgerow you'd better get some shutters installed quick-smart!

The AI will also now make use of any DLC buildings you happen to own. As we've only currently released one pack they will only make use of the buildings in that pack. However, as your collection increases so too will the AI's collection. You know what they say about sharing and caring, don't you?

In addition, for anyone who hated the voices of the tenants but preferred the soothing ramblings of the narrators, you can now mute the tenant voices. This feature is accessed from within the tenant selection screen as a new toggle button. This will only need to be toggled once.


[h1][u]BUILDING PACK TWO - [I]Out Soon[/I][/u][/h1]
We appreciate the patience of the fans who have supported us since release and, as a gift, we will be making the second building pack free for two weeks in February. Be sure to pick it up while its hot! You can see the buildings it will include below - a fine set of accommodation, and utilities, for your picky tenants.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/ec85dda64cda52764a68ed2ea208b0a3de078138.png[/img]


[H1][u]MULTIPLAYER[/u][/h1]
Multiplayer is one of those things that's been plaguing us for quite some time now, and whilst the previous patch put it in a good spot it became clear that there was still room for improvement. Over the last few months we have been extensively testing multiplayer and, we believe, our efforts have bore fruit - delicious digital fruit to be specific! I am, of course, referring to the new and improved net-code!

The changes to the net-code are rather significant when put into perspective. If you recall, issuing orders was often a chore in and of itself, and you'd be sporting a full beard before you'd placed your first building. Obviously, this was not acceptable, and we have looked at different ways of alleviating this issue for our fans. With the new and improved net-codes you'll be issuing orders faster than an overworked employee at Starbucks, and you'll look good doing it too! 

In less round-about terms, your performance will be much better than it was previously. If you've tried to play with someone from across the globe or who has a less than ideal connection, then you will no longer have time to order a pizza, then eat it, before your game realises that you asked it to do something thirty minutes ago. Or your pizza is free.

In addition to this, the game will be much more consistent later on when lots of things are happening. One of the biggest causes of delay was during the late game when lots of characters were doing whatever they do, and when workers were finally using their nailguns for something other than nailing themselves to the supports of your latest building. As a result, feel free to engage in lots of fighting without the game fighting to keep itself in sync!

On the topic of sync, or more specifically desync, we have tracked and eliminated several additional causes of the aforementioned loss of sync. We are cautious to advertise it as completely desync free, but we believe we have got the main culprits. Of course, if you do experience a desync then let us know and we'll investigate it! It's worth mentioning that clients who go out of sync with the host will have a nifty "1" displayed in the bottom-left corner of their screen. If this is not being display then you have not gone out of sync! 

Whilst we are confident that even people who have low bandwidth can still stream Netflix, and build, we advise against doing that as there will be times where the game needs to catch up. However, it will mostly be a short delay and it will keep everything synced up juuuust right.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/538bfb6f53bb1379ab2ae6789c0164a31abc0122.png[/img]


[h1][u]MISSIONS[/u][/h1]
The missions are another part many of you will be wondering about, and unfortunately we weren't able to launch any with this update. Whilst the missions themselves are close to being implemented, we are still waiting on the narrations (starring Mr. Challis himself), as well as the translations for each one. We understand that this is somewhat disappointing for those who have been waiting, but we want to make sure that they do not have any glaring issues of stability like the good ol' tutorial.

As previously mentioned, the missions will be a mixture of story-based, and goal-oriented missions like those found in Street Wars, as well as mini-challenge missions which give you very specific set of goals for the entire level. We can confirm that Constructor Plus will also contain its own missions on top of the base ones. We are very much looking forward to sharing all of them with you, the wonderful fans of Constructor.

In the coming weeks we may provide sneak peeks at the missions to give you, the curious fans, a little more in the way of information. However, we will do our best to stop short of completely spoiling the missions.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/f64177b7ccb5cb1e9c039243dc8889f629103692.gif[/img]

[h1][u]OVERALL GAME STABILITY[/u][/h1]
For many of you Constructor runs just fine, but there is always the odd issue that comes up when you least expect it, and steals five hours of progress from you. We have used the time since the last update to rigorously stamp out yet more crashes, and fix a bunch of other bugs with the game so that you can get back to building a better world!

We expect that for the vast majority of fans the game will have no problems, and things will run as expected. However, we still have a list of issues to work through, including the infamous 'walking on the spot' glitch that shows up to steal away an undesirable from you, or the unsuspecting AI. 

By the way, if you're just joining us now and are curious on how things have changed you can take a look at the previous patches in order of release [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/2333276539592903541/]here[/url], [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/2333276539592888942/]here[/url], [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/2592234299532974890/]here[/url], and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/1471966894866582148/]here[/url]. In addition you will find the supplement thread for this patch [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/1693785669867232655/]here[/url]. 

[h1]WHAT'S NEW IN THIS UPDATE?[/h1]
[code]
[h1]New Features[/h1]
• Tenant voices can now be muted in the 'Assign tenant screen'.
• HQ fences will now change depending on the map the player has selected.
• Changed fence for several classic buildings.
• Allow player to access options from in-game pause menu.
• Allow computer to choose more variety of fences for each tenant type.
• Allow computer to build DLC houses.
• Fence defence no longer influences take-over hits but instead provides a bonus to property defence against nearby explosions.
• Number of tenants, cadets, and mob favours available can now be changed in Designer mode.

[h1]General Fixes[/h1]
• Certain complaints are no longer specific to a difficulty level and can instead be adjusted using "Complaints Included" in the options menu.
• Sending a worker into an enemy utility no longer lets you interact with the building.
• Game can no longer be saved during the tutorial which caused issues if the tutorial was reloaded whilst player was inside a building.
• Tutorial progress no longer impeded as a result of getting a tenant too early.
• Fixed crash when jumping from house gadget screen to exterior gadget placement.
• Game will no longer crash when jumping from the Prison screen to the residential manager, estate manager or external gadget placement screens.
• Fixed corruption to background which occurs when visiting Missions/Police/Mob screen from house gadget screen.
• Fixed road sections that were missing in Riverside and Concrete City.
• Fixed a bug which caused complaints which stopped rent being paid to still affect rent in War Mode.
• War Mode can no longer be started without at least one opponent.
• Fixed a crash which occurred if the HQ exploded while the player had the HQ open.
• Player will no longer hear flames from enemy buildings that are off-screen.
• Fixed issue with juddering footprint when auto placing houses which had the potential to cause the game to crash if a building was placed illegally as a result.
• Game will no longer display incorrect tenant info for "Infested" or "Squatter tenants".
• The game will no longer crash as a result of the thief attempting to steal a weapon from an enemy Mob HQ.
• The thief no longer walks on the spot when attempting to steal a weapon from an enemy Mob HQ.
• Fixed an issue where characters were attacking beyond their range.
• Fixed looping situation when going overdrawn in Designer mode.

[h1]Multiplayer fixes[/h1]
• Multiplayer code has been updated to resolve issues with extreme delay.
• Thug Rave no longer causes multiplayer to desync.
• Fixed an issue involving Mr.Fixit's electrify ability.
• Prevent crash when joining network game in some languages.

[h1]Localisation[/h1]
• Russian localisation now released.
• Allow Cyrillic usernames in saved games.
• Additional adjustments to Portuguese Brazilian.

[h1]Hot Fix - 30/01/18[/h1]
• Reverted a change to the maximum number of Mob Favours and Police Cadets so that this maximum value is only applicable during Designer mode. Bear in mind that you can go over this limit if you create gangsters, but this will have no effect as gangsters have their own cap.

[/code]

We hope that you enjoy the latest update, and we look forward to sharing even more of Constructor with you as we move through 2018. 

Thank you for your continued support, and patience. We couldn't ask for a better fanbase! ːlovekami_heartː

- System 3

[h1][u]CONSTRUCTOR - ABOUT BLOODY TIME! UPDATE[/u][/h1]

Yes, you wonderful people, that's the sound of an update being released for Constructor, and it's about bloody time if you ask us! Now, we realise that the last time we released an update for the game man had only just discovered fire (has it really been that long?!), but we've been hard at work improving multiple areas of the game. So, whilst your update is in progress let's sit down and talk about some of these improvements.

Oh, but where are my manners? I am, of course, the brightful BrightPaw who will be bringing you yet another announcement from within the bowels of hel-System 3. So without further ado, let's take a trip down patch-way pass. Oh, and don't feed the programmers!


[h1][u]NEW FEATURES[/u][/h1]
In this patch we will be introducing a number of new things to Constructor.

The first is, of course, the new net-code but as this has its own section down below we will save the nattering until then.

When you start the game up you may notice several new fences in the game which can be built for your tenants. Each of these have their own defensive values as well as stress factors. On the topic of defensive values, the value displayed for fences no longer correlates to a rough idea of how many hits they can take before a foreman removes it. 

Each fence now provides a bonus to the property it surrounds in terms of protecting from nearby explosions. So, if you're planning on building a hedgerow you'd better get some shutters installed quick-smart!

The AI will also now make use of any DLC buildings you happen to own. As we've only currently released one pack they will only make use of the buildings in that pack. However, as your collection increases so too will the AI's collection. You know what they say about sharing and caring, don't you?

In addition, for anyone who hated the voices of the tenants but preferred the soothing ramblings of the narrators, you can now mute the tenant voices. This feature is accessed from within the tenant selection screen as a new toggle button. This will only need to be toggled once.


[h1][u]BUILDING PACK TWO - [I]Out Soon[/I][/u][/h1]
We appreciate the patience of the fans who have supported us since release and, as a gift, we will be making the second building pack free for two weeks in February. Be sure to pick it up while its hot! You can see the buildings it will include below - a fine set of accommodation, and utilities, for your picky tenants.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/ec85dda64cda52764a68ed2ea208b0a3de078138.png[/img]


[H1][u]MULTIPLAYER[/u][/h1]
Multiplayer is one of those things that's been plaguing us for quite some time now, and whilst the previous patch put it in a good spot it became clear that there was still room for improvement. Over the last few months we have been extensively testing multiplayer and, we believe, our efforts have bore fruit - delicious digital fruit to be specific! I am, of course, referring to the new and improved net-code!

The changes to the net-code are rather significant when put into perspective. If you recall, issuing orders was often a chore in and of itself, and you'd be sporting a full beard before you'd placed your first building. Obviously, this was not acceptable, and we have looked at different ways of alleviating this issue for our fans. With the new and improved net-codes you'll be issuing orders faster than an overworked employee at Starbucks, and you'll look good doing it too! 

In less round-about terms, your performance will be much better than it was previously. If you've tried to play with someone from across the globe or who has a less than ideal connection, then you will no longer have time to order a pizza, then eat it, before your game realises that you asked it to do something thirty minutes ago. Or your pizza is free.

In addition to this, the game will be much more consistent later on when lots of things are happening. One of the biggest causes of delay was during the late game when lots of characters were doing whatever they do, and when workers were finally using their nailguns for something other than nailing themselves to the supports of your latest building. As a result, feel free to engage in lots of fighting without the game fighting to keep itself in sync!

On the topic of sync, or more specifically desync, we have tracked and eliminated several additional causes of the aforementioned loss of sync. We are cautious to advertise it as completely desync free, but we believe we have got the main culprits. Of course, if you do experience a desync then let us know and we'll investigate it! It's worth mentioning that clients who go out of sync with the host will have a nifty "1" displayed in the bottom-left corner of their screen. If this is not being display then you have not gone out of sync! 

Whilst we are confident that even people who have low bandwidth can still stream Netflix, and build, we advise against doing that as there will be times where the game needs to catch up. However, it will mostly be a short delay and it will keep everything synced up juuuust right.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/538bfb6f53bb1379ab2ae6789c0164a31abc0122.png[/img]


[h1][u]MISSIONS[/u][/h1]
The missions are another part many of you will be wondering about, and unfortunately we weren't able to launch any with this update. Whilst the missions themselves are close to being implemented, we are still waiting on the narrations (starring Mr. Challis himself), as well as the translations for each one. We understand that this is somewhat disappointing for those who have been waiting, but we want to make sure that they do not have any glaring issues of stability like the good ol' tutorial.

As previously mentioned, the missions will be a mixture of story-based, and goal-oriented missions like those found in Street Wars, as well as mini-challenge missions which give you very specific set of goals for the entire level. We can confirm that Constructor Plus will also contain its own missions on top of the base ones. We are very much looking forward to sharing all of them with you, the wonderful fans of Constructor.

In the coming weeks we may provide sneak peeks at the missions to give you, the curious fans, a little more in the way of information. However, we will do our best to stop short of completely spoiling the missions.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/f64177b7ccb5cb1e9c039243dc8889f629103692.gif[/img]

[h1][u]OVERALL GAME STABILITY[/u][/h1]
For many of you Constructor runs just fine, but there is always the odd issue that comes up when you least expect it, and steals five hours of progress from you. We have used the time since the last update to rigorously stamp out yet more crashes, and fix a bunch of other bugs with the game so that you can get back to building a better world!

We expect that for the vast majority of fans the game will have no problems, and things will run as expected. However, we still have a list of issues to work through, including the infamous 'walking on the spot' glitch that shows up to steal away an undesirable from you, or the unsuspecting AI. 

By the way, if you're just joining us now and are curious on how things have changed you can take a look at the previous patches in order of release [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/1698300679759913735/]here[/url](2017). You will find the supplement thread for this patch [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/1698300679759933694/]here[/url].

[h1]WHAT'S NEW IN THIS UPDATE?[/h1]
[code]
[h1]New Features[/h1]
• Tenant voices can now be muted in the 'Assign tenant screen'.
• HQ fences will now change depending on the map the player has selected.
• Changed fence for several classic buildings.
• Allow player to access options from in-game pause menu.
• Allow computer to choose more variety of fences for each tenant type.
• Allow computer to build DLC houses.
• Fence defence no longer influences take-over hits but instead provides a bonus to property defence against nearby explosions.
• Number of tenants, cadets, and mob favours available can now be changed in Designer mode.

[h1]General Fixes[/h1]
• Certain complaints are no longer specific to a difficulty level and can instead be adjusted using "Complaints Included" in the options menu.
• Sending a worker into an enemy utility no longer lets you interact with the building.
• Game can no longer be saved during the tutorial which caused issues if the tutorial was reloaded whilst player was inside a building.
• Tutorial progress no longer impeded as a result of getting a tenant too early.
• Fixed crash when jumping from house gadget screen to exterior gadget placement.
• Game will no longer crash when jumping from the Prison screen to the residential manager, estate manager or external gadget placement screens.
• Fixed corruption to background which occurs when visiting Missions/Police/Mob screen from house gadget screen.
• Fixed road sections that were missing in Riverside and Concrete City.
• Fixed a bug which caused complaints which stopped rent being paid to still affect rent in War Mode.
• War Mode can no longer be started without at least one opponent.
• Fixed a crash which occurred if the HQ exploded while the player had the HQ open.
• Player will no longer hear flames from enemy buildings that are off-screen.
• Fixed issue with juddering footprint when auto placing houses which had the potential to cause the game to crash if a building was placed illegally as a result.
• Game will no longer display incorrect tenant info for "Infested" or "Squatter tenants".
• The game will no longer crash as a result of the thief attempting to steal a weapon from an enemy Mob HQ.
• The thief no longer walks on the spot when attempting to steal a weapon from an enemy Mob HQ.
• Fixed an issue where characters were attacking beyond their range.
• Fixed looping situation when going overdrawn in Designer mode.

[h1]Multiplayer fixes[/h1]
• Multiplayer code has been updated to resolve issues with extreme delay.
• Thug Rave no longer causes multiplayer to desync.
• Fixed an issue involving Mr.Fixit's electrify ability.
• Prevent crash when joining network game in some languages.

[h1]Localisation[/h1]
• Russian localisation now released.
• Allow Cyrillic usernames in saved games.
• Additional adjustments to Portuguese Brazilian.

[h1]Hot Fix - 30/01/18[/h1]
• Reverted a change to the maximum number of Mob Favours and Police Cadets so that this maximum value is only applicable during Designer mode. Bear in mind that you can go over this limit if you create gangsters, but this will have no effect as gangsters have their own cap.

[/code]

We hope that you enjoy the latest update, and we look forward to sharing even more of Constructor with you as we move through 2018. 

Thank you for your continued support, and patience. We couldn't ask for a better fanbase! :lovekami_heart:

- System 3

notes.title: January Patch, an apology, and a gift to our wonderful fans!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/c0fa25608d24a6ad227aa11e4dfe193d79844e4b.jpg[/img]

Merry January to you, the beautiful fans of Constructor! 

It is I, the Brightful BrightPaw with another announcement. However, before we touch on what's what... How is everyone? Has the new year been treating you well? Let's hope it has been well!

We know a lot of your were probably expecting more information on Constructor Plus, but we wanted to address concerns regarding our baby, Constructor, before we continue to tell you all of the new things that are on the way. Stay tuned for more news on that later this month. ːlovekami_heartː

So what is the kerfuffle? Well, Constructor will be receiving an update this January to address online issues, crashes, and a few adjustments to correct some of the cheekier issues. Goodbye, gangster that fires a shotgun well beyond its intended range! We'll not miss you! (Just kidding, he may be missed in single player...) 

BTW does "kerfuffle" sound like a type of candy, or is it just me? Anyways...

In addition to the patch, we want to acknowledge all of the fans who have supported us since last year. We have very much appreciated any feedback positive or negative, and are impressed with the level of patience some of you possess (it's over 9,000!!!!) It's great to have one of the best fan bases a development team could ask for, and we look forward to continuing to share the wonderful world of Constructor with you, the ever supportive fans.

On the note of sharing, we will be giving to all of our fans the option to pick up building pack two absolutely free. An announcement will go out on the same day, so be sure to pick it up as soon as possible. Please be aware that it will only be free for two weeks starting from the release of the pack, although many of you are very fast so we expect you will pick it up within... Carry the two, and multiply it by the speed of a foreman's clipboard... a very fast time! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/ed0344f9b250e40c2a0d009e42fe3f97694396e2.png[/img]

We are very sorry for the delays in getting the latest update out, and we completely understand that for many of you it has been quite the wait. However, our primary concern was putting our heads down, digging through the code, and squashing the bugs that were keeping you, the FANtastic fans (sorry about that one), from being the best property developers this side of riverside.

It was also our desire that we conduct emergency surgery on the multiplayer code, and I can safely say that we have ripped out many of the problems plaguing it. We believe it will be a much better experience where the time it takes to issue an order does not equate to you growing a full beard, or becoming a skeleton. We are definitely looking forward to unleashing the new multiplayer code on all of you! It will be especially wonderful seeing the kind of Constructor-related mayhem that you, the fans, will unleash upon each other in four player mode. Be sure to share the details of your victory (or loss) with us! ːfhappyː

Once again, thank you for your support. Let's make 2018 a great year together! ːlovekami_heartː

We will be taking an in-depth look at some of the new skyscrapers very soon, as well as some of the additional space levels. 

And now... if you'd like a little closer of a look at what's in building pack two... Then click this [url=https://imgur.com/a/zIjiQ]link[/url], and you'll sink, into a world of pure Americanization.

I've just been told I am to get off the stage effective immediately... 


[I]Quick-note: To PS4 owners who may also happen to visit us on Steam, note that the second building pack will be going live in two weeks at which point you may pick it up for free. [/I]

ːlovekami_heartː System 3

notes.title: Constructor Patch 4 - Better Homes and Gardens Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/2fcc6414ccda776adfb28b1ace85bccfe823c36b.png[/img]
[h1]UPDATE - 01/08/17[/h1]

We have released a hotfix to squash a few bugs (hopefully for good!) Hop on over to the mini-thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/1471966894886914757/]here[/url]!

[h1] Constructor Patch 4 - Better Homes and Gardens Update[/h1]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HaDLWGENECU&feature=youtu.be]Patch 4 HYPE[/url]! Let's all be as excited as this guy!

Welcome to Constructor's fourth patch, you lovely people! It is I, your brightful BrightPaw with another amazing announcement for you, the beautiful fans of Constructor! What a month it's been and what an update we have in store for you! After much deliberation we tracked and squashed the slow-motion issue that would've made Neo blush! It's our hope that these changes also carry over to multiplayer and allow our wonderful fans to participate in some juicy four player chaos!

In addition we've made a fair few changes to the multiplayer code and hope that your experience is much better. As such we would appreciate your feedback on the latest multiplayer fixes. Why the long wait for all of this? Well... it Texas time to implement all of these wonderful things! 

Oh, come on, it wasn't that bad of a pun. Erm, speaking of Texas...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/221ca41f935f273e1900fa6c0fb9447134a2becf.png[/img]

We're happy to announce that our second set of blue-prints will soon be ready for your estate manager to review! These prints were inspired by some of the more unique offerings of the good ol' US of A and were collected over what can only be described as "the world's longest road trip." It's also at this point you, the lovely reader, are trying to imagine what a car full of developers would look like and it's with great sadness I must report that it was more of a tour bus.

The set of blue-prints will explore a variety of architecture from the shabby trailers of Montana, the weathered houses of Cape Cod all the way up to the grand Neo-Classical design. If you're feeling particularly patriotic then you'll be glad to know you can express it in the form of the towering Monument of Washington or the awe-inspiring Statue of Liberty - your tenants will be glad you did!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/b91f5ce8fc628423c50b4c75b2a8bc46cf4c903a.png[/img]

We hope to have these blue-prints ready for your use very soon and hope that you love the look of the new buildings. Our favourites are the "Wright Modern" and the "Airstream Trailer". If you have a particular building you're looking forward to using let us know in the comments!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/b6312e58f5615e3ae757ba46076c63efac4aa965.png[/img]

If you're just joining us now and you're curious on how things have changed you can take a look at the previous patches in order of release [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/2333276539592903541/]here[/url], [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/2333276539592888942/]here[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/2592234299532974890/]here[/url]. In addition you will find the supplement thread for this patch [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/1471966894866582148/]here[/url]. 

Of course, if you're simply after the latest changes in this patch you will find them below!

[code][h1]What's new in this patch?[/h1]

[h1] New Features [/h1]
[list]

[*] Brazilian-Portuguese is now available - special thanks to Octávio Augusto whose assistance in proof-reading the translation was greatly appreciated! ːfhappyː

[*] Garden objects (such as garden furniture) can now provide different happiness (or stress) to tenants.

[*] Tenants will now gain happiness from certain fences.

[*] Tenant's rent is also influenced by the house itself – not just the free-hold value. 

[*] Breeding speed can be influenced by the sort of house a tenant is placed inside. This affects each tenant differently! 

[*]DIY Repair Kits – two for one special. You can now manufacture two repair kits at a time rather than one, and the factory cap has been lifted to ten at a time in storage. This should help our fans keep their buildings in check late-game!
[/list]

[h1] General Fixes [/h1]
[list]

[*] Attempting to move characters to illegal positions on certain parts of Burgerville no longer causes the game to crash. 

[*] Falling below 60FPS no longer causes the game to enter into super slow-motion. 

[*] Police will no longer get stuck when attempting to arrest a deceased character.
[/list]

[h1] Multiplayer Fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Ingame message character limit increased to 80.

[*] Network lobbies are no longer displayed until they have been fully initialised.

[*] Friends can no longer join your game through the friend's list if they're already in a game with you. 

[*] Slow machines should no longer cause issues during multiplayer games. 

[*] Multiplayer lobbies are no longer able to be joined after the game has started.

[*] Host setup no longer causes players to be thrown out during custom game startup.

[/list]

[/code]

We would like to thank all of our faithful Constructor fans for their continued support and patience, and wish you all a wonderful week of Constructor!

[h1] Constructor Patch 3 - Fixes, features and more![/h1]

Hello, developers! 

We've just received some very important information that our gadget factory is placing the finishing touches on the next patch for Constructor. The foreman running the place has assured us that these are his best innovations yet - we'll believe it when we see it!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/c7fdbd453c05facb395b403529881508820a75ce.gif[/img]

It looks like the last few additions are being packaged now...

We don't remember this many garden gnomes being essential for a patch but the foreman has assured us that this is standard procedure at every gadget factory. We may need to bring him in for questioning after this as there is evidence to support the fact that he may not actually be qualified for the job.

Enough blabbering we'll deal with him later. For your convenience we have included the condensed notes in this announcement but you can find the usual commentary in the patch notes section of the forum [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/2592234299532974890/]here[/url]. You may also wish to view the previous patches which can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/2333276539592903541/]here[/url]  and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/579020/discussions/1/2333276539592888942/]here[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/aa2efe552f06e2e2cdea35ae822d3fbc272177bd.png[/img]
We will also be trialling the latest multiplayer fixes. This means that the release will be clamped to a maximum of two players to make sure that everything is running smoothly before we open up three and four player games. During this period we would greatly appreciate your feedback on your experience with multiplayer over the weekend.

We thank you for your continued support and patience.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/37ed9764685c966ba56bf916352315f41f3a48e4.gif[/img]

[code]
[h1]General Fixes[/h1]
[list]

[*][b]A number of fail-safe fixes have been applied to prevent crashes which were identified from Xbox One crash dumps.[/b]

[*][b]Swapped movie player over to using Bink in order to allow 60fps videos, improve compatibility, avoid loop stalls and improve performance.[/b]

[*][b]Replaced Jungle icon to remove visible cursor.[/b]

[*][b]Auto convert of previous saved games for compatibility. [/b]

[*][b]Overcrowding/creation of Level 1 Tenants is no longer caused by the presence of a Hospital.[/b]

[*][b]Fixed designer mode saving to the wrong place.[/b]

[*][b]Added backwards compatibility to Small Town saves made prior to the first patch to prevent crashing.[/b]

[*][b]Disabled Function Keys during Tutorial to avoid invalid actions.[/b]

[list]

[*][b]You can now toggle character animations to either play once or always.[/b]

[*][b]AI will now be able to attack one another as a toggle in options. You will find this in the gameplay options menu.[/b]

[*][b]AI build speed can now be adjusted in 10% increments from 50% to 400%. You will find this in the gameplay options menu.[/b]

[*][b]Implemented old-school site placement with toggle. [/b]

[*][b]Added timing info to HQ screen showing how long before next available child. [/b]

[*][b]Implemented shortcut keys for resources, conflict & tenant complaint icons.[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 – Wood Yard

[*] 5 – Cement Yard

[*] 6 – Brick Yard

[*] 7 – Steel Yard

[*] T – View tenant complaints

[*] F – Scroll up estate agent

[*] V – Scroll down estate agent

[*] S – repeated presses will cycle through each level of tenant housing

[*] N – Go to last conflict
[/list]

[*][b]Clicking on a complaining tenant's video will also show their complaint letter. [/b]
[/list]

[h1]AI Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Picketing an AI's resource will no longer permanently stop any buildings currently undergoing construction.[/b]

[*] [b]Resolve lack of resources for computer AI after having resources picketed.[/b]

[*] [b]AI are now more aware of any empty estates and will send repairmen accordingly.[/b] 
[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Gain access to Gadgets earlier in Multiplayer mode.[/b]

[*][b]Stopped players being able to start games with DLC dependant maps if they've been in a network game with someone who owns it. [/b]

[*][b]Detection and warning about version when attempting to join multiplayer game to make sure that you have the latest version to avoid incompatibilities. [/b]

[*][b]Players will no longer be able to see their old network game when re-entering lobby whilst remaining players are still in the game. [/b]

[*][b]Correct lobby name when migrating host.[/b]

[*][b]Stop lobby becoming visible when game host is migrated during gameplay. [/b]

[*][b]Stop network error dialogs showing when not necessary. [/b]

[*][b]Network messages are no longer corrupted due to server handover. [/b]

[*][b]Changed size of messaging window in lobby to see more messages.[/b]

[/list]
[/code]

[h1]Please Note[/h1]
As Steam is currently in the midst of the summer sale madness you may experience a slow patching process – this is unfortunate but we just know you're going to love the newest additions! We appreciate the continued patience and dedication to the game that our fans continue to show. We thank each and every one of you for your continued support and look forward to bringing you more updates in the future!

We wish you all a very wonderful weekend!

notes.title: FREE PC DEMO UPDATE... 21.9 SCREEN RESOLUTIONS NOW UPDATED AS WELL AS OTHER MONITOR RESOLUTION SIZES NOW ADDED
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/083467d37092e393ac05b0c88429ead441cdf562.jpg[/img]

Many thanks to all of our fans that continue to support us and give us valuable feed back that keeps improving the game. Please keep them coming..

The changes in the latest free demo version address the following issues:-
 
1. Multi-monitor support – the mouse is now constrained to the primary monitor allowing push scrolling of the screen on machines with multiple monitors.
2. Desktops smaller than 1920x1080 are now catered for properly allowing scaling and mouse push scrolling
3. Desktops resolutions larger than 1920x1080 now function correctly and the game is scaled to maximise the display
4. Game crashes following Windows suspend mode have been fixed
5. We have options to allow switching between full screen and 16:9 aspect ratios to prevent distortion on extreme wide screen or 4:3 monitors.  This feature will be enabled tomorrow.

Future update additions to the game.
1. We will add the option to include the old control system in the options menu. 
2. Free mission update packs that are planned every few weeks
3, Continued updates and new game play additions
4. A submission site for maps will be set up in future for fans to get their maps in the game. These will be blended in to the code and chosen by the fans that will nominate monthly maps to go in. These can be created with the map editor. They will need to be hard coded in.

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE TO OUR FANS
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/53450b246048b4dd468a47bae1ab537a3d80844c.png[/img]

1. When the game first became visible on Steam, the executable Constructor.exe did not go live at the same time.  However, this was corrected within a couple of hours and therefore should no longer be an issue.
2. We have had numerous accounts of anti-virus programs giving a false positive virus warning on the executable Constructor.exe – as a result some anti-virus programs such as Bullguard and Windows Defender have been putting the executable into quarantine.  For example with Bullguard, even telling it that it is a false positive does not prevent the program quarantining it again later.  If this is a problem and the executable keeps disappearing, the best way is to configure your anti-virus so that excludes the Constructor.exe from being checked.
3. There was a fault with the packaging of the game whereby it did not configure DirectX and Visual C correctly.  This has been corrected and hopefully this will have resolved many of the Windows 10 problems.  However, we are unsure whether all of the changes will take place automatically.  It may require uninstalling and re-installing.
4. A last minute addition to the game added a system call to CreateFile2 which caused problems on Windows 7 machines.  We are currently attempting a workaround.  We are about to update the game which will hopefully resolve the problem although there are other more complex issues which may need to be addressed.This will not been done until Wednesday.
5. There are a number of issues surrounding multiple monitors or people with very high resolution displays which will be addressed in the coming week.
We will be implementing the ability to define the full screen size in the coming days too.

notes.title: CAN CONSTRUCTOR FANS WITH WINDOWS 10 PROBLEMS PLEASE TRY THE DEMO AGAIN. AN AUTO UPDATE WILL SOLVE MOST WINDOWS 10 USERS PROBLEMS
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28226051/53450b246048b4dd468a47bae1ab537a3d80844c.png[/img]

Can fans that had problems with Windows 10 please try again and give us feedback if it works. If it doesn't on your machine it helps no one to be rude. A new patch that will fix most Windows 10 configurations and issues is now up. 

If it still does not work check you Anti-virus protection program. Some Anti-virus programs are not recognising the code as white label and they are deleting exe files. This has caused most of the Windows 10 issues. It means some drivers are not loaded in with the game. This should now work on most configurations.

Windows 7 will not have a patch until Wednesday at the earliest. The issue is that Microsoft has stopped fully supporting this operating system since October. An option to change screen size that is in the final game will also be added after the Windows 7 issue is resolved. 

Thank you for your patience.
